subject: warning() display on javascript console in Chrome

messages.author: f1a78b77bed56547
messages.subject: warning() display on javascript console in Chrome
parts:
Hello,

I used to rely heavily on using "warning()" to display messages to the javascript console in Chrome for debuging Shiny apps running on server pro. But for some reason the messages are not displaying any longer. What could be the cause, and how may I get the messages back?

Jonathan

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: warning() display on javascript console in Chrome
parts: Those messages would generally only show up there if the R process crashes. For logs while the app is running, you can look in /var/log/shiny-server/*.log.
